name: stillbroken
description: StillBroken: every reported civic problem stays public until it is fixed

scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --omit=dev && cd ../frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
